query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create", "/create")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("SYSTEM", "HIGHEST", "Administrator")
| extend TaskName = extract(@"/TN\s+([^\s]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Action = extract(@"/TR\s+([^/]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, TaskName, Action, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where isnotempty(TaskName)
notes: Detects creation of scheduled tasks with high privileges. Extracts task name and action for analysis. Reduces false positives by requiring privilege escalation indicators.
attack_scenario: Attacker creates scheduled task for persistence or privilege escalation, often with SYSTEM or Administrator privileges
expected_detections: Malicious scheduled tasks, persistence mechanisms, privilege escalation attempts
